help.title: How to play
help.move: Move with the arrow keys or WASD. On a phone drag the joystick, tap a spot on the ground or pick a place from the bar at the bottom.
help.enter: Get close to a building's door and press E (or Enter) to go in: the page for that place opens. Clicking the building works too.
help.fast: Fast travel takes you straight where you want, and Tab steps through the places one by one.
help.extra: The ` key opens the terminal, Esc closes panels.

terminal.help:
available commands:
  about              who I am in two lines
  stack              the technologies I use
  projects           the main projects
  contact            how to reach me
  ls                 the places in the world
  go <place>         go to a place (e.g. go scuola)
  theme <light|dark> change theme
  lang <it|en>       change language
  clear              clear the screen
  exit               close the terminal
